description: Feed row action must be ADD, UPDATE, MOVE or INACTIVATE and required columns must be present.
node_code must be unique within a version (including within a single feed file).
node_name must be at most 60 characters.
Organization leaf codes must be exactly 5 characters and limb codes cannot exceed 5 characters.
The parent node must exist in the target hierarchy.
The parent node must be a LIMB (leaves cannot have children).
A node cannot be moved under itself or one of its descendants.
Values of attributes with a reference list must exist in that list.
Nodes at level 2 must be OCs: code is OC followed by 3 numbers. OC codes may only be used at level 2.
Limbs at level 3 are BGs: code must be exactly 2 uppercase letters.
Limbs at level 4 are BUs: code must be exactly 3 uppercase letters.
Leaf nodes must be below level 4 (level 5 or deeper).
Limb codes below level 4 must be 4 or 5 characters long.
Limb codes must not be 5 numeric characters (that format is reserved for cost centers).
A limb with active children cannot be inactive.
Active leaves must have GL_COMPANY, LEDGER_ID and ACCOUNTING_CURRENCY.
ACCOUNTING_CURRENCY should equal the currency of the node's ledger (ledgers.csv).
